name: Airline flight reservations
detail: Customer service for airline flight reservations. Book, change or cancel flight reservations; cabin class and fare rules; change fees and cancellation refunds. Policies cover: verifying the customer's identity (e.g. name plus a postcode, email or booking reference) before looking up or changing anything; eligibility windows and status rules; fees, penalties and compensation amounts; refunds back to the original payment method; the customer must approve each change before it is made; some requests must be refused because the policy does not allow them; requests outside the policy are handed to a human agent.

name: Online retail item exchanges
detail: Customer service for online retail item exchanges. Exchange delivered items for another variant (size, colour, model) of the same product; price differences. Policies cover: verifying the customer's identity (e.g. name plus a postcode, email or booking reference) before looking up or changing anything; eligibility windows and status rules; fees, penalties and compensation amounts; refunds back to the original payment method; the customer must approve each change before it is made; some requests must be refused because the policy does not allow them; requests outside the policy are handed to a human agent.
